title: 贝森特出手稳债：分析师却说历史证明很难，下一步会怎样？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We just heard from Treasury Secretary Scott Besend. Are you full of confidence now?
segments.zh: 我们刚刚听到财政部长贝森特的发言。你现在有信心吗？

segments.en: No, I'm not. But, however, I think historically, you know, the history has demonstrated that
segments.zh: 不，我没有。但历史表明，干预市场是非常困难的。

segments.en: it is very difficult to intervene in the market. However, market will take as the first step of confidence that they will be, he's got a lot of bullets and that he is, you know, he's well-liked,
segments.zh: 然而，市场会将其视为信心的第一步，认为他有很多手段，而且他在市场内广受欢迎和尊重。

segments.en: well-regarded within the markets and that he has a focus of getting it down. So, you know, that does send quite a bit of confidence into the market. Now, of course, we seem a bit of volatility,
segments.zh: 他专注于压低收益率，这确实给市场带来了不少信心。当然，我们看到了一些波动，回吐了所有涨幅。

segments.en: giving up all the gains. However, we do think that this is one of the many steps to come, and then that should alleviate some of the concern for the time being.
segments.zh: 但我们认为这只是众多步骤之一，暂时应该能缓解一些担忧。

segments.en: There are a lot of other variables in this picture, though, as well, and not the least of which companies such as Broadcom that we mentioned in the introduction seeking 60 billion in financing,
segments.zh: 不过，这个局面中还有很多其他变量，尤其是像博通这样的公司，正如我们开头提到的，寻求600亿美元的融资。

segments.en: following on a lot of other companies in this space as well. How's that clouding the picture?
segments.zh: 这个领域还有很多其他公司也在这样做。这如何使局面变得复杂？

segments.en: And how is the starting to get difficult for the Fed? Yeah, look, I think the difficulty here is that we are seeing a lot of companies requiring a lot of debt. And the difficulty for the Fed is that,
segments.zh: 这对美联储来说是不是开始变得困难了？是的，我认为困难在于我们看到很多公司需要大量债务。

segments.en: you know, you clearly have upward pressure on the yields. And, you know, if you're going to borrow money and then to buy back the bond, it's going to become harder for the short term. At the same time,
segments.zh: 对美联储来说，困难在于收益率明显面临上行压力。如果你借钱回购债券，短期内会变得更难。

segments.en: you have near term, you know, the shorter term is also pressuring higher as well. So, that is the challenge. Now, I think for investors in this sort of environment, you do want to be mindful of
segments.zh: 同时，短期收益率也在走高。这就是挑战。我认为在这种环境下，市场参与者需要注意。

segments.en: the companies who's requiring a lot of debt, because these bond yields will stay higher for longer.
segments.zh: 那些需要大量举债的公司，因为债券收益率将在更长时间内保持高位。
